description: First vertex of the first record of each projected shapefile, as stored in the .shp (projected CRS units) and converted to WGS84 longitude/latitude with pyproj (PROJ) using the EPSG definition. Use it to unit-test the app's own reprojection. RGF93 and NAD83 are treated as coincident with WGS84 (PROJ's default, no grid shift), so lon/lat equal the datum's own geographic coordinates.
